stories.title: OpenAI seeks to accelerate $30B round at valuation above $1.4T
stories.summary: OpenAI is negotiating to speed up a roughly $30 billion financing round at a valuation above $1.4 trillion, with SoftBank Group and MGX reported in talks to join, according to sources cited by Reuters via The Star. ChatGPT now has 1.2 billion weekly active users, and the money is earmarked for compute and datacenter expansion after this month's GPT-6 rollout, as OpenAI tries to accelerate the round ahead of rival IPOs including Anthropic's expected IPO.

stories.title: DHS bans DeepSeek from civilian agencies, orders removal
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security published notice on Oct. 20 of an order barring DeepSeek from civilian agency purchasing and ordering agencies to remove it, including third-party products built using DeepSeek. The order reaches past DeepSeek's own app to products developed using DeepSeek implementations, with no carve-out for open weights run on US servers, according to TopFive's summary of the Federal Register notice.

stories.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, its production inference stack
stories.summary: DeepSeek said in a Tuesday, Oct. 20 post on X that it has made its in-house inference framework DeepInfer fully open source, saying DeepInfer powers its DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model at scale with high throughput and low latency. DeepSeek said it is sharing its production stack to help the community lower compute costs, reduce energy use and make AI more affordable, and it is also open sourcing deepseek-recipe, its production token encoding and decoding component aligned with its official API.

stories.title: Musk announces X algorithm change to reward posts people read
stories.summary: Elon Musk announced on Oct. 20 two updates to X's timeline recommendation system: a new AI ranking model built to better predict how long users will spend on content, and a retrieval model that favors posts people actually read to the end. The changes could affect For You feeds by giving greater importance to meaningful attention rather than relying exclusively on familiar engagement signals such as likes, reposts and replies, and Musk claimed active user seconds on X are growing exponentially and hitting new all-time highs nearly every day.

stories.title: Hacker breached 100+ sites using AI agents; Microsoft adds controls
stories.summary: Reuters reported that a hacker used agentic tools to breach more than 100 company sites, including John Deere and SharkNinja, with little human intervention. Microsoft introduced enterprise controls that can assess agent risk and stop risky agent actions, putting AI agents on both sides of the security problem in the same day's news.

stories.title: Four Gemini agents beat Minecraft with no human help in 27 hours
stories.summary: Four Google DeepMind agents powered by Gemini 4 Argon defeated Minecraft's Ender Dragon with no human intervention, working individually while sharing tips, threats and mistakes through in-game chat and shared memory. The agents split up tasks, warned each other about threats and recovered items from dead teammates, completing the run in 27 hours and 14 minutes after writing 2,783 programs and dying 605 times, in what researchers call the first end-to-end autonomous completion using only the standard Mineflayer library.
